mapper.update: UPDATE user_posts SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS post_id, p.post_type AS post_type, p.title AS post_title, p.content AS post_content, u.nickname AS writer_nickname, p.created_at AS post_created_at, p.updated_at AS post_updated_at, p.views AS post_views FROM user_posts p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT pi.id AS image_id, pi.image_url AS image_url, pi.deleted AS image_deleted, pi.uploaded_at AS image_uploaded_at, pi.updated_at AS image_updated_at, pi.deleted_at AS image_deleted_at, pi.post_id AS image_post_id FROM post_images pi WHERE pi.post_id = #{postId} AND pi.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pi.uploaded_at ASC, pi.id ASC
